---
title: "Mark an Order as Delivered"
description: "Record that a shipment has reached the customer."
---

Marking a fulfillment as delivered records that the customer has received their items. You do this from the order's detail page after the fulfillment has shipped.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the orders list">
    Go to **Orders** in the sidebar. The page lists the orders that include your products. Select the order you want to work on.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/mark-an-order-as-delivered/step-1.png" alt="Open the orders list" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the order">
    Selecting a row opens the order's detail page, where you manage fulfillment, shipping, payments, and returns for your part of the order.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Review the order">
    The detail page shows the order's items, customer, payments, and fulfillment status. Work from here.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/mark-an-order-as-delivered/step-3.png" alt="Review the order" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Mark the fulfillment as delivered">
    In the **Fulfillment** section, open the actions menu for the shipped fulfillment and choose **Mark as delivered**. This completes the fulfillment lifecycle for those items.
  </Step>
</Steps>
